snapshot.statement: This fixture is NOT an unmodified upstream repository. It is a reduced snapshot of the upstream runtime surface with deliberate baseline defects introduced for benchmark tasks.
snapshot.upstreamSourceSha256Covers: the retained upstream paths listed in retainedUpstreamPaths, hashed from the pristine upstream checkout BEFORE any Rapture transformation

transformations.detail: Retained only the upstream runtime distribution surface (index.js, classes/, functions/, internal/, ranges/, range.bnf) plus LICENSE and README.md. Removed the upstream test suite, benchmarks, CI/GitHub metadata, lint/commit tooling configuration, changelog and contributor docs, bin/ and preload.js.
transformations.rationale: The upstream test suite runs on `tap`, which requires a network package install. Removing it lets the fixture be materialized and validated fully offline with zero dependencies, which the experiment requires for determinism.

transformations.detail: Replaced package.json with a minimized CommonJS manifest: name changed to semver-core, devDependencies and all scripts removed, files/main/engines/license/author retained.
transformations.rationale: Prevents any install or lifecycle script from running and makes clear this is not the published semver package.

transformations.detail: Added PROVENANCE.md declaring the fixture as a derived, defect-injected snapshot.
transformations.rationale: Anyone reading the fixture in isolation must not mistake it for upstream semver.

transformations.detail: Rewrote functions/diff.js to drop the prerelease-to-release special casing.
Rewrote functions/coerce.js to remove support for the rtl and includePrerelease options.
Rewrote internal/lrucache.js as an unbounded Map wrapper with no recency tracking and no eviction.
Added test/range.test.js, a Rapture-authored node:test suite (not upstream) whose baseline revision asserts stale expectations and therefore fails.

notIncluded.upstreamTests: removed; benchmark acceptance is decided only by external validators under benchmarks/real-work-v1/validators/
notIncluded.dependencies: none; the retained surface has no external require() targets
